short: A Cherokee-class brig-sloop that carried Charles Darwin on a five-year voyage of exploration.
full:
Launched in 1820 from Woolwich Dockyard, HMS Beagle saw no immediate action and was later adapted into a survey barque. She undertook three major hydrographic expeditions. Her second voyage, departing in 1831 under the command of Captain Robert FitzRoy, carried a young naturalist named Charles Darwin.

During the nearly five-year circumnavigation, the Beagle charted the coasts of South America and visited the Galapagos Islands. The geological and biological specimens Darwin collected, along with his meticulous observations, laid the foundation for his theory of evolution by natural selection. The ship spent her final years as a static coastguard watch vessel before being dismantled in 1870.
